reviews.title: Not Challenging Enough
reviews.text: I’ve done several of the programs and I’m not impressed.  I think all of the programs are purely for beginners just starting out.  The amount of exercises per workout are too few, too long of rest periods, and I find it hard to challenge myself.  I’ve gained weight since doing programs on Alive in the last 6 months of using it.  I’ve used so many different apps and programs for over a decade and this is one of the few that I am not impressed with.  I like the app layout, but the workouts themselves don’t feel like complete workouts.  I didn’t pay for an app so I can create my own, I pay so I don’t have to think or plan my workouts.  I’m frustrated because I still have a long time on my subscription but I’m done using this app.  It’s not good enough.

reviews.title: Love Whit
reviews.text: The app itself is very user friendly. My issue lies with the customer service and no-refund policy. Unfortunately, this tainted my view on the entirety of the app.

reviews.title: Kept charging me once it was cancelled
reviews.text: I love the Alive app I use it a lot back in 2024. But I cancelled my account in January and kept getting charged for months. They claim they can’t do any refunds which just seems like a money grab to me. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Good luck trying to cancel
reviews.text: Like the title says, they don’t care about you. They just care about their “policies” on their site and getting as much money as possible. Cancelled my membership right before the free trial ended and have now been charged two months in a row. Thankful for my CC company recognizing it as a scam. Beware!

reviews.title: It wasn't for me
reviews.text: I had a very frustrating experience with the app. Contacting support was not helpful. Unfortunately, terms and conditions will trump customer satisfaction every time!

reviews.title: 0 stars
reviews.text: Why can’t I cancel? I shouldn’t have to jump through hoops to cancel? If I get charged I will be disputing. And you can’t even contact anybody? What a sloppy app!!!

reviews.title: Doesn’t save my workouts
reviews.text: I like the programs and the workouts however when I go in later in the week it shows that I did rest days on everyday when I didn’t. I made to complete the workout and everything but then I goes away. It says I haven’t done any workouts in the 3 weeks I’ve been doing the program.

reviews.title: Very Basic
reviews.text: Simple and efficient interface. Workouts however are very basic and not fitting for someone experienced. No variation in workouts. No actual coaching. Wish I could get a refund

reviews.title: This sucks
reviews.text: This app freaking suck so much literally it says that you don’t have to pay it only says you have to pay for premium so when I downloaded it I was so excited to finally get a work out app for free then I hit in a signed up and then I tried to start a work out and it didn’t let me access any workouts and then I tried to like find a free one there one no free ones and when I tried anything else and like the journal or the other stuff it said you have to become a premium member and pay either a $114 thing each year or $14.99 a month all in all this app sucks

reviews.text: the app is advertised as a free app with some in app purchases which is understandable.  but i got on there today and tried start a work out for the first time.  anytime i hit a button of any of the plan or just day of work outs with oficia areas it asked me  to buy premium. i do not recommend this app if you are trying to have a simple free work out for free i would rather use youtube. now im left scrambling to find a work out 👎👎👎

reviews.title: Nothing free
reviews.text: It seems like nothing is free, there is a seven day free trial. But in those seven days you better spam every workout you want other whose you have to pay like 14 a month.

reviews.title: Fraud
reviews.text: Joined back in 2020 when the app was released and signed up. To this day - 1/21/2026 am still having charges attempted to my card. NO customer service what-so-ever. I have not had any concerns or issues that I have reported listened to. I do not use this app, and used it for maybe one month 5 years ago and stopped… WHY am I still being charged when I changed my card multiple times and did NOT authorize a charge. I cancelled services in 2020. 5 years of charging someone who does not log into the app should be reviewed… CLEAN UP YOUR SYSTEM.

reviews.title: Unkind customer service
reviews.text: No humanity or kindness, just copy and pasted policy back to me.

reviews.title: Signing up is a nightmare
reviews.text: I signed up via the website for a 7 day trial. It’s been a nightmare to cancel ever since. Asking if I signed up on the app OR online OR via apple. Why is the signup different for each platform?! Why can’t I access my Scooby through the app if I sign up on the website using the same credentials?! Why can’t I cancel on the app??? I was already charged for the year and now I’m being told to transfer my account from one platform to another before I’m charged AGAIN FOR THE YEAR?! What?!!

reviews.title: It’s ok. Limited flexibility
reviews.text: It’s okay so far. A lot of it is repetitive. And i hate how it logs old work outs - I’ll complete one and then the day passes and it logs it as a rest day instead of documenting the day i did. And there’s no flexibility to switch days around. Yesterday i was sore so i took a rest day and wanted to do upper body today. I thought i could just click on the work out from the day prior. Nope, it’s locked as a rest day and I’ve lost access to that work out. Pretty annoying considering the price. I won’t renew.
